responsibility: Defines the LoongArch backend’s static target property tables and canonical string mappings. It initializes CPU name tables, default ISA selections, cache characteristics, issue rates, DFA lookahead, RTX cost data, code model and ABI/ISA string arrays, switch-name arrays, and the minimal ISA required by each ABI, giving the rest of the backend a central data source for option normalization, tuning, diagnostics, and cost modeling.
same_name_distinction: Provides the definitions and initializers for the LoongArch static configuration tables declared by the loongarch-def pair, including CPU string maps, default ISA/cache/cost data, switch names, and ABI minima. Unlike loongarch-def.h, it is the data-definition unit rather than the type/code declaration header.
